svg.text: MPx-BLM-020 · Wiring, seals, fasteners, material spec
MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. All wiring silicone-insulated 0.75 mm² (18 AWG), 200 °C rated, inside the core; PVC allowed only in the base.
2. Heater loop current 3 A at 20 V; fuse 5 A fast-blow; PD trigger set to 20 V (solder jumper or switch).
3. No PCB: the wax gate (P14) and the overflow standpipe (P11) provide all process control.
4. Earth/drain: shell P03 bonded to supply −ve via 1 MΩ + 10 nF (ESD); 20 V SELV, no mains inside.
24 V DC, runs at 20 V (~17% slower)
Ø6 × 30, 6.7 Ω (bench: 24 V part, 24 V PSU)
return (−) to PD trigger / USB-C GND
Production cartridge wound for 20 V 60 W (6.7 Ω): ~22 W steady load, warm-up ≈ 15 min. A stock 24 V 60 W part gives only ~42 W at 20 V, so bench-test it on a 24 V PSU.
all hot wetted tube, drawer, mesh
